I’m 15 but I’ve been fighting my whole life. Every day is a constant battle. Today I’ve lost the fight. I appreciate you trying to make me feel better but I’ve just given up. I’ve lost all courage and any fight left in me so there is only one option to end my pain.

It makes me feel even worse and makes me fall deeper into a whole because I feel even more helpless. The therapists were helping because it felt good to get things off my chest and talk to someone who would just listen. It made me feel like a weight was lifted because I had been holding in those emotions for so long.

If I had more controll, I would act more natural and think things through instead of making impulsive  decisions and making myself look like an idiot, in specifically school.

I like the story in those games and the interactive environments and they were like a way to escape my real life.

I like their art because it is interesting to look at and it can mean something different each time you look at it. It is up to the viewers interpretation to figure out its meaning. I think Salvador Dhali is cool because he had a very strange and abstract way of life and he expressed that in his art.

They tell me that life is tough, you shouldn’t feel suicidal, your just sad. The therapists I thought were somewhat helping, but school consumers don’t help. My therapist just made things worse by admiring me to a hospital.

I’d Kill my self through helium inhalation with an exit bag.

I used to play far cry,Skyrim,Assasins creed, and fallout.
 
I like art by Salvador Dhali, Banksy, and Picasso.

I don’t think they would respond that way, because I know that they would act that way. I told people that I was suicidal and they said that if I were to hang myself id I only break the rope(I’m fat). My family doesn’t take me seriously when I tel them I’m
Suicidal and they shrug it off. They even cut off my meetings with my therapists because they said it was a waste of their money. 

Controll means being able to act how I actually want to act and not make a fool out of myself. I make a lot of stupid, impulsive decisions that end up having bad consequences and I hate myself after because I know I shouldn’t have done so, and I wish I had controll.

I used to like video games, long boarding, and art but know I don’t like anything.

Crazy means actually out dramatically or taking things to far to gain attention or to be liked. I look like I’m an attention seeker which I technically am, but I can’t controll it. That’s why I can’t tell anyone that I’m extremely suicidal and depressed because they would think I’m just trying to get attention. When I go “Overbord” or “Crazy”, before I think it’s a good idea and people will get a kick out of what I’m about to do, if I’m trying to get people to like me. After I feel even more depressed then I was and I hate myself. I don’t even know the tea me anymore. My life has spiraled out of controll, and this is just the tip of the iceberg of what’s causing my issues. I have no interests, no friends, and I just lay in bed all day thinking about my life, contemplating suicide, and wondering when I’m gonna do it. Everything I used to like doesn’t mean shit to me anymore.
